New orders
OFF: a loud ringtone plays on the Orders page until you Accept or Reject each new order. ON: orders are accepted automatically and the customer gets the ETA. Stock is still checked at checkout.
Stock
When a product reaches 0 stock it disappears from your store and the shop home, and comes back by itself when you add stock. Hidden products stay in your dashboard. You get a "Low stock" alert at the level above and a "Sold out" alert at 0.
Timings
If both are empty, the store is always open according to its status. Overnight hours also work (e.g. 18:00 to 02:00). The times above apply to every day, unless you set a different time for a day below.
